plugin.name: Arcade Machine
plugin.description: Three office games in your IDE: Turkish Wordle, Higher / Lower and live drawing rooms. Connect to your office's Arcade Machine LAN server for shared daily challenges and live leaderboards.
plugin.change-notes: Drawing invitations now join the invited room directly and open it after confirmation. Closed-room errors stay in the invitation. Screen transitions isolate game content and defer hidden canvas rendering; returning to a room restores its latest drawing. Compatible with Arcade server 0.3.0.
